_about: Every public-domain George MacDonald (1824-1905) text the Word Hoard holds: the fantasies and fairy tales, the Scottish and English novels, the sermons and theology, poetry and criticism. CCEL ThML first (31 works), Gutenberg for the rest, Internet Archive OCR (raw) for three books online nowhere else. Everything here was published before 1930 and is US public domain.

macdonald-back-of-north-wind: At the Back of the North Wind (1871)
macdonald-day-boy-night-girl: The Day Boy and the Night Girl (1879)
macdonald-diary-of-an-old-soul: A Book of Strife in the Form of the Diary of an Old Soul (1880)

macdonald-light-princess-other-stories: The Light Princess and Other Fairy Stories (collection)
macdonald-dish-of-orts: A Dish of Orts: Chiefly Papers on the Imagination, and on Shakespeare (1893)
macdonald-englands-antiphon: England's Antiphon (1868), an anthology of English religious verse with MacDonald's commentary
macdonald-hamlet-study: The Tragedie of Hamlet: A Study with the Text of the Folio of 1623 (1885)
macdonald-hidden-life: A Hidden Life and Other Poems
macdonald-poetical-works-1: The Poetical Works of George MacDonald (1893), vol. 1
macdonald-poetical-works-2: The Poetical Works of George MacDonald (1893), vol. 2
macdonald-rampolli: Rampolli: Growths from a Long-Planted Root (1897), translations and poems

macdonald-dealings-with-the-fairies: Dealings with the Fairies (1867), the first fairy-tale collection
macdonald-threefold-cord: A Threefold Cord: Poems by Three Friends (1883), ed. MacDonald
